fields.description: When a Material Request or Purchase Order is submitted, each WBS and cost code on it is checked: this document plus open orders plus actual cost against the WBS budget.
fields.label: Budget check on requests and orders

fields.description: Warn: submit and show the overrun. Stop: refuse the submit. Off: no check.
fields.label: When Over Budget

fields.description: How far over the budget a document may go before the check acts, e.g. 5 allows 5% over.
fields.label: Tolerance (%)

fields.description: A tender quotation whose margin is below this goes to Pending Management Approval before it can be submitted.
fields.label: Minimum Quotation Margin %

fields.description: Sales Order lines for work whose cost head names no contract works item use this item.
fields.label: Default Contract Works Item

fields.description: Payment terms an awarded Sales Order takes when it has none.
fields.label: Contract Payment Terms

fields.description: Sales taxes (VAT) an awarded Sales Order takes when it has none.
fields.label: Contract Taxes

fields.description: Material is wanted on site this many days before the task that uses it starts.
fields.label: Site Buffer (days)
